caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with two drawers. Each drawer has two round knobs placed symmetrically on either side and a keyhole in the center above the knobs. The box has a flat top surface, and the wood is illustrated with a varnished finish that shows natural wood grain patterns in shades of brown and reddish-brown. The edges and corners of the box are sharply defined. The overall composition features the box positioned at an angle, showing the front and right side, with the top surface also visible. The background is a plain, light beige color. In the bottom left corner, the name “WELLINGTON BLEWETT” is written in small capital letters.
title: Bishop Hill: Chest
